chapter: Los Angeles scene and the Ellington sound
title: Guaranteed salary and who was highest paid
summary: Brown denies being highest paid and says only a few men were paid whether the band worked, with Hodges higher.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: and you were the highest paid member of the band.
No. I have never had a contract. I -- no way became anywheres near the highest paid member. I think --
He said you and Johnny were almost on an equal par, and that you two were the highest, but you made a few more dollars than Johnny.
That You and Johnny had an arrangement where you got your salary whether you -- the band worked or not.
There were only maybe five people who got -- had that kind of an arrangement.
Yes, but the amount of the weekly salary was -- I don't think was near Johnny's, which -- rightfully so. Johnny was really a terrific contributor.
